svg.title: KORA Roasters — Concept 1: Architectural Typographic Wordmark
svg.desc: Bold architectural geometric sans-serif wordmark for KORA Roasters with refined proportions, precision datum rules, and widely tracked ROASTERS subline in espresso #2C211E on a transparent background.
